core_obligations: Construct a local parametrix at the endpoint plus one by the same pattern as at the endpoint minus one, with the model problem solved by the corresponding Bessel type functions (proof lines 1468-1480).
Verify the jump relations of the constructed parametrix on the contour and draw the auxiliary picture used to describe the contour (proof lines 1470-1520).
Match the constructed local parametrix with the outer one on the boundary of the disc and invert the matching relation to bound the quotient of the two (proof lines 1520-1583).
Deduce the uniform growth bound at the endpoint plus one and the boundedness of the quotient and of its boundary values away from the two endpoints (proof lines 1583-1587).
proof_roadmap: Construction of the local parametrix at plus one (proof lines 1468-1480).
Jump relations and the contour picture (proof lines 1470-1520).
Matching with the outer parametrix (proof lines 1520-1583).
Growth bound and boundedness away from the endpoints (proof lines 1583-1587).
